tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Return the full markdown of one documentation page, addressed by the `source` path reported in a search result (for example `php/micro-orm/active-record.md`). Use it when a search hit is relevant but truncated and you need the whole page.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Inventory of everything indexed, grouped by category and project, with document and passage counts. Use it to discover which ByJG libraries have documentation before searching.
